title: Leadership competency 1 — practical application
body: This BLACK Level 2 lesson develops practical leadership and executive-management competency. Learners should connect leadership decisions to trust, communication, delegation, accountability, organisational systems, people development, risk and measurable outcomes. The objective is to distinguish authority from influence, adapt leadership to circumstances, make evidence-based decisions and understand the wider consequences of executive choices. Examples should be adapted to the organisation, workforce, market and regulatory environment.
